## Checklist

- [ ] I made this, or I have the rights to share it under the licence in `item.json`
- [ ] No logos, brands, pictures of real people or personal details
- [ ] My item is in `items/<kind>/<my username>/<name>/`, with the `id` the check gave it
- [ ] If I changed an item, I raised its `version`
- [ ] `node tools/validate.mjs` passes for my item
- [ ] I looked at the preview (`node tools/preview.mjs`), and it draws what I meant
